title: Primitivity of the SU(2n)_{2n} superconducting series
assuranceBoundary: The universal primitivity result is a written analytic proof claim. Finite exact computations test formulas and implementations only; they are not formal proof, physical validation, independent human peer review, exhaustive novelty certification, an official REF decision, or completed publication.

claims.statement: For every even N=2n>=4 in the specified charge-one SU(N)_N construction and every nonzero q modulo N, the resolved sector rank satisfies R_0-R_q>=N/2 and the sector contains two distinct simple objects exchanged by electron fusion. The rank-electron obstruction therefore excludes every allowed electron-compatible invertible-superconductor vortex factor, including Abelian-dressed factors, and the family is primitive in the originating sense.
hypotheses: unitary SU(N)_N WZW modular category with N even and N>=4
the charge-one fermionic simple-current construction of Gao et al.
fine flux sectors q in Z/N
electron-compatible factorisation convention of the originating definition
limits: not a new construction of the family
not a complete fusion-rule or crossed-braiding classification
not a microscopic or experimental result
not formally verified

claims.statement: The parity-zero sector of the charge-one fermionic condensate is represented by modules over the even subgroup algebra A=sum_{g in <J^2>} g; its simple objects are the resolved even-subgroup orbits, and the image of J acts as the retained physical electron while the original fine charge grading remains in force.
limits: uses all A-modules, not only local modules
specific to the stated charge-one construction and grading

claims.statement: If h(a) is the stabiliser order of a parent label under H=<J^2>, cyclicity linearises the stabiliser cocycle, the orbit resolves into exactly h(a) simple modules, and R_q=(2/N) sum_{Q(a)=q} h(a)^2.
limits: cyclic resolution machinery is prior work
full stabiliser size need not be the resolved multiplicity outside the cyclic setting

claims.statement: Established exact cyclic charge counts imply A_L(0)>A_L(r) for every nonzero residue r, and the resolved-rank expansion consequently gives R_q<R_0 for every nonzero q modulo N.
limits: the unrestricted charge formula and strict zero-residue maximum are prior work
the claimed residual contribution is their fine-sector superconducting application

claims.statement: For every even N>=4 and every nonzero q modulo N, R_0-R_q>=N/2. The proof keeps an integer gap of at least one in every applicable charge-count term, uses positivity for omitted neutral terms, and applies sum_{d|m} J_2(d)=m^2 with m=N/2.
limits: an elementary corollary of prior exact counting and the resolved-rank formula, not a new counting theory
N=4, q=2 is an equality example; no equality classification is claimed

claims.statement: Under the originating electron-compatible factorisation convention, a rank mismatch excludes the two-object invertible-vortex factor and a nontrivial electron two-cycle excludes the one-object electron-fixed factor; invertible Abelian dressing preserves both obstructions.
limits: an elementary unpacking of the originating factor definition, not a general new categorical theory
does not classify arbitrary factorisations outside the stated convention

claims.statement: For every nonzero q, the parent label with a_0=N-1 and a_q=1 has full rotation period N; its two distinct even-subgroup orbits induce simple objects exchanged by the physical electron.
limits: the witness fails at excluded boundary N=2
no complete electron permutation of every short-orbit resolution label is claimed

claims.statement: Direct H-orbit enumeration covers N=2,4,6,8,10; an independent dynamic program checks 5,050 charge cells for lengths 1 through 100; independent Jordan counts run through 50; exact ranks agree for every even N from 2 through 100; and the quantitative gap holds for every checked even N from 4 through 100. Normal and optimized tests and five semantic negative controls pass under CPython 3.13.5, and both public evidence files replay byte-identically.
limits: finite exact checks are not the universal proof
the parent-orbit diagnostic does not determine electron fixation of individual resolved constituents
the computations assume the separately audited categorical resolution
final clean-extraction archive binding, remote CI, and provider parity remain publication gates

claims.statement: The supplied AI-assisted review recommended minor revisions and gave a central prospective 2-star overall assessment, with a credible specialist uncertainty toward 3-star and no supported 4-star case.
limits: not human peer review
not an official REF decision
not a correctness probability
the obstruction lemma and quantitative gap do not automatically raise the assessment

explicitNonClaims: a new unrestricted charge-counting formula or strict charge maximum
an equality classification for the quantitative rank gap
absolute historical priority or a first-proof claim
complete fusion rules or crossed braiding
